_doc: Measured micro-cues (seconds, song timeline) that are finer than or correct analysis/timing.json. Measured from the demucs stems (work/demucs/htdemucs_ft/song) with 5 ms RMS envelopes and an FFT pitch track (2026-10-14, engine lead). Post-stop accent hits land 50-80 ms AFTER the grid times listed in timing.json accent_hits; use these. Access in code: T.cue('act1.whistle_notes')[i].

act1.stop1_note: re-hit transient measured at 17.44 (soft pickup at 17.39)

act4._doc: Team C, measured 2026-10-14 from the demucs stems + out/cache/song.wav (5 ms RMS). NOTE: timing.json's final-chorus stop/hit times are ~0.3 s LATE: the band actually cuts at 137.03 (bass off, last drum 136.80), the lone hit transient is 138.595 (on beat 138.612), and the SLAM transient is 139.395 (on beat 139.411; the 808 swells to full by ~139.70). Bridge triplet roll actually runs 133.105-135.81 (triplet 8ths, ~0.134 s).

act5._doc: Team D, measured 2026-10-14 from demucs stems (5-20 ms RMS). timing.json drop-2 stops are ~0.3-0.4 s late; the impact 174.395 is right (drum pickups at 174.015/174.22 lead into it).
